tasks.label: Show Account Settings Diffs
tasks.command: git diff -- src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.tsx src/services/accountService.ts src/types/auth/ProfileSettings.ts || true

tasks.label: Git Diff Stat
tasks.command: git diff --stat -- src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.tsx src/services/accountService.ts src/types/auth/ProfileSettings.ts; echo '---done---'

tasks.label: Check Specific Git Status
tasks.command: git status --short src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.tsx src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.test.ts src/services/accountService.ts src/types/auth/ProfileSettings.ts && echo '---' && git diff --stat -- src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.tsx src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.test.ts src/services/accountService.ts src/types/auth/ProfileSettings.ts

tasks.label: Show Exact Diff
tasks.command: git diff -- src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.tsx src/pages/account/AccountSettingsPage.test.ts src/services/accountService.ts src/types/auth/ProfileSettings.ts | Out-String -Stream | Select-Object -First 200
